description: Declarative lifecycle event hooks and skill mappings for dsuo agent environments

on_session_start.description: Fires when an agent begins a task or session; establishes environment readiness

on_pre_review.description: Fires before requesting review, uploading a CL, or pushing a branch; gates on verification

on_user_correction.description: Fires when user provides feedback or points out a defect; converts to red regression test

on_change_landed.description: Fires after code merges into main or task reaches done; harmonizes feature map
